name: daedalus-harness
description: Orchestration only: server/, client/ and agent/ are three independent packages (this is deliberately NOT a pnpm workspace). Each script just cd's into a package and runs its own typecheck or test.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:client && pnpm typecheck:server && pnpm typecheck:agent
scripts.test: pnpm test:client && pnpm test:server && pnpm test:agent
